rents.range_basis: 10th-90th percentile over 30 tracts of ACS 2020-2024 rent of units built 2020 or later over all rented units
rents.evidence: python -m jobs.check_rents_acs: ACS 2020-2024 B25111 (median gross rent of units built 2020 or later) over B25064 (all rented units), median over 30 tracts with lots in Dallas. Units built 2010-2019: 1.043 over 128 tracts.
rents.caveat: Census rents include long-tenure leases and utilities; no public rent rolls outside Chicago. Replace with a rent source when one is available.

property_tax.rate_note: Dallas County 2026 rates inside Dallas ISD: Dallas County 0.22465, Dallas College 0.106575, Parkland Hospital 0.212, City of Dallas 0.6978, Dallas ISD 0.985735.
property_tax.caveat: Non-homestead rate for an in-city lot; special districts some lots pay are not included.

impact_fees.basis: Dallas charges no water, wastewater or roadway impact fees. The park land dedication fee in lieu is the per-unit development fee.

components.name: Dallas park land dedication fee in lieu
components.note: 2018 rates (Ordinance 30934): $762 land + $403 development per single-family or duplex unit; $917 per multifamily unit with 2 or more bedrooms ($457 for 1 bedroom). Council amended the fee on 2025-11-12 (Ordinance 33280); staff proposed $1,308 per house. The adopted amounts were not found in an official text, so the 2018 rates stay until confirmed.

components.name: Dallas water and wastewater impact fee
components.note: None: 'The City of Dallas does not charge utility impact fees as other Cities do' (city fee study, 2023-12-04). Meter and lateral inspection fees ($465.50, rising to $656 under the FY2026-27 fee ordinance) are permit fees.
